_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "last4" TEXT NULL, "account_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_expected_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_confirmed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "merchant" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_text_encrypted" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_recurring" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_recurring" IN (0, 1)), "recurring_group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_groups (id), "is_international" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_international" IN (0, 1)), "is_flagged_unusual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_flagged_unusual" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "user_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_edited" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "raw_merchant" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "kind_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("kind_locked" IN (0, 1)), "transfer_group_id" TEXT NULL, "refund_of_id" TEXT NULL, "refund_hint" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("refund_hint" IN (0, 1)), "also_in_source" TEXT NULL, "source_hash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alerts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "alert_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dismissed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "monthly_limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_month_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("setting_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "setting_value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("setting_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "own_identifiers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_shares" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "person_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "share_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "settled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("settled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unparsed_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_code" TEXT NULL, "raw_text_encrypted" TEXT NOT NULL, "hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("resolved" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lending_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_settled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_settled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "transaction_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lending_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lending_entries (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parser_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_code" TEXT NULL, "pattern_encrypted" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "hits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "month_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obligations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "biller" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "is_max_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_max_amount" IN (0, 1)), "min_due_minor" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "umrn" TEXT NULL, "account_last4" TEXT NULL, "ref_last4" TEXT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_code" TEXT NULL, "source_hash" TEXT NULL, "matched_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
